_comment: AWS Launch Template + Mixed Instances Policy for the BioMate vLLM ASG. Apply with `aws ec2 create-launch-template-version` + `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group` — see docs/20260528_VLLM_DEPLOY_RUNBOOK.md. UserData must be base64-encoded from cloud-init.yaml after substituting ${target_group_arn}, ${aws_region}, ${ecr_image}, ${ecr_registry}, ${efs_id}.

_mixed_instances_policy._comment: 100% spot. Cost target: ~$165-330/mo for desired=2 nodes (vs $1,760/mo for the prior 80/20 5-node plan). If a region-wide spot squeeze evicts all nodes, the Galaxy backend falls back to Gemini Flash via the existing _call_local_regulatory_llm fallback chain — degraded but not down. ASG sizing: min=1 max=4 desired=2.
